name: Lot
summary: Abraham's nephew, who traveled with him to Canaan and then chose to live near Sodom. When the LORD destroyed Sodom, angels led Lot and his family out, but his wife looked back.

key_moments.title: Going with Abram
key_moments.description: When Abram left Haran for the land of Canaan, his nephew Lot went with him.

key_moments.title: Choosing the Jordan Plain
key_moments.description: Lot and Abram had too many flocks to live together, so Abram let Lot choose where to go. Lot chose the well-watered plain of Jordan and pitched his tent toward Sodom, where the men were very wicked.

key_moments.title: Rescued by Abram
key_moments.description: Kings at war carried off Lot and his goods from Sodom. Abram armed his trained servants, chased them, and brought Lot back.

key_moments.title: Escape from Sodom
key_moments.description: Two angels warned Lot that the LORD would destroy Sodom, and they led him, his wife and his two daughters out by the hand. As fire and brimstone fell, Lot's wife looked back and became a pillar of salt.
